skill: Applied maths, statistics and scientific practices
expected_level_description: You can: - identify opportunities to develop statistical insight, reports and models to support organisational objectives, while collaborating across the organisation effectively - critique statistical analyses - use a variety of data analytics techniques (such as data mining and prescriptive and predictive analytics) for complex data analysis through the whole data life cycle - use model outputs to produce evidence and help design services and policies - understand a broad range of statistical tools, particularly those deployed within the organisation, and can use these appropriately and help others to use them
You can: - work with data engineers and data scientists to design and provide products for the organisation

You can: - oversee compliance with data ethics standards and legislation across the organisation - develop, manage and continuously improve an ethical framework within your area - develop a data ethics culture, influencing others to act on it - ensure data ethics is applied appropriately when formulating, implementing and evaluating organisational policies and programmes

You can: - demonstrate practical knowledge of data science tools and techniques - develop data science solutions that maximise insight - identify opportunities for how data science can improve data practices

You can: - champion the role of data science within the organisation - understand and champion user research, and can design and manage processes to gather and establish user needs - identify and create opportunities to develop and deliver data science products to support organisational objectives, while collaborating across the organisation to fulfil meaningful goals - take responsibility for delivering scalable data science products into the organisation, and establishing maintenance support

You can: - act as a leader or technical specialist, providing detailed support and guidance within the organisation and helping colleagues to develop skills - set the direction of CPD (continuous professional development) within your team - keep up to date with new developments in data science and can match those to opportunities in your organisation - talk confidently about the benefits of data science approaches to existing and potential customers - demonstrate an in-depth understanding of a wide range of data science techniques, such as machine learning and natural language processing, and detailed knowledge of at least one specialism - use these techniques to build data science solutions, including reports, models and dashboards
You can: - write and test scripts and create basic models in one or more languages - collaborate on shared codebases, using a variety of methodologies

You can: - understand the differences between delivery methods, such as Agile and waterfall, and can choose the most appropriate method to deliver each product - define the minimum viable product (MVP) and support decisions about priorities - work with specialists in multidisciplinary teams to smoothly deliver data science products into the organisation

You can: - shape organisational strategy using a deep understanding of the health and care system - represent the organisation with health and care partners and leaders - anticipate how policy and service changes will affect digital services and care

You can: - lead data protection impact assessments and information sharing agreements - advise teams on lawful basis, consent, confidentiality, and retention - investigate incidents and recommend improvements

skill: Safe and fair AI in health care
expected_level_description: You can: - set the organisation's standards for assuring and monitoring AI in care - lead the assurance of high-risk models before and after deployment - represent the organisation with regulators and partners on safe and fair AI

You can: - lead hazard identification and risk assessment for a product or change - write and maintain hazard logs and clinical safety case reports - agree risk controls with product teams and check that they work - advise teams on applying clinical risk management standards
You can: - assess whether a product is a medical device, and its likely class - plan the regulatory work for a product with quality and clinical colleagues
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession
You can: - hold and manage a budget, forecasting and explaining variances - build a business case with costs and benefits
